component: Manual filter dialog completion, target folder and button state

quotes.text: gRunningFilters should be true while filters run

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The operation callback clears the dialog's running flag and recomputes Run Now eligibility instead of enabling the button unconditionally. Eligibility depends on selected filters, a run folder and the server's after-the-fact capability. The selected picker path clears an unresolved folder and the last-filter deletion path updates selection/buttons. Browser tests check flag completion and news-folder create/delete button states; they do not test every mid-run state change, failure or close/cancellation path.
title: Filter completion recalculates Run Now eligibility from the current dialog state
